description:
## 1.36.0-dev.76 (2026-08-09)

- Reddit: improve preview video quality selection by ranking all candidate streams and demoting tiny CMAF/DASH renditions.
- Reddit: make P/T text previews fetch and fill missing post body text from selected post JSON when feed cache is empty.
- Reddit: add B as a conservative previous-comment hook when Reddit exposes that native control.
- Reddit: make the G web modal try to expand read-more/NSFW view prompts automatically.
